question: Which model years of the Kia Telluride are covered by recall 26V430000?
question_ko: 리콜 26V430000의 대상 텔루라이드 연식은?
gold_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?y WHERE { ?c rc:campaignNumber "26V430000" ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:modelYear ?y }

question: Which component categories are recalled in campaign 10V388000?
question_ko: 리콜 10V388000의 결함 부품 분류는?
gold_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?n WHERE { ?c rc:campaignNumber "10V388000" ; rc:affectsComponent ?k . ?k rc:name ?n }

question: On what date did NHTSA receive the defect report for recall 23V651000?
question_ko: 리콜 23V651000의 결함 보고 접수일은?
gold_sparql: SELECT ?d WHERE { ?c rc:campaignNumber "23V651000" ; rc:reportReceivedDate ?d }

question: How many vehicles are potentially affected by recall 26V430000?
question_ko: 리콜 26V430000의 잠재 대상 대수는?
gold_sparql: SELECT ?n WHERE { ?c rc:campaignNumber "26V430000" ; rc:potentiallyAffected ?n }

question: List every Hyundai, Kia or Genesis recall campaign that carries a 'Do Not Drive' advisory.
question_ko: '운전 금지' 권고가 붙은 리콜 캠페인을 모두 나열하라.
gold_sparql: SELECT ?cn WHERE { ?c rc:doNotDrive true ; rc:campaignNumber ?cn }

question: Which of these recalls were influenced by NHTSA's OVSC (Office of Vehicle Safety Compliance)?
question_ko: OVSC(차량안전기준 준수국) 주도로 시작된 리콜은?
gold_sparql: SELECT ?cn WHERE { ?c rc:initiatedBy "OVSC" ; rc:campaignNumber ?cn }

question: Which recall campaigns received in 2024 affect the Hyundai Palisade?
question_ko: 2024년에 접수된 리콜 중 팰리세이드가 대상인 캠페인은?
gold_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?cn WHERE { ?c rc:campaignNumber ?cn ; rc:reportReceivedDate ?d ; rc:affects/rc:ofModel/rc:name "PALISADE" . FILTER(YEAR(?d) = 2024) }

question: Which vehicle models, across all three brands, have been recalled for the component 'SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE'?
question_ko: ABS 제어 모듈 결함으로 리콜된 차종을 브랜드 구분 없이 모두 나열하라.
gold_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?m WHERE { ?c rc:affectsComponent/rc:name "SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE" ; rc:affects/rc:ofModel/rc:name ?m }

question: Among detailed component categories that appear in both Hyundai and Kia recalls, which one appears in the most campaigns?
question_ko: Hyundai와 Kia 리콜에 모두 나온 세부 부품 분류 중 캠페인 수가 가장 많은 것은?
gold: SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE

question: Which single recall campaigns cover vehicles of more than one brand (Hyundai, Kia, Genesis)?
question_ko: 한 캠페인에 두 개 이상 브랜드의 차량이 함께 들어간 리콜은?
gold_sparql:
SELECT ?cn WHERE { ?c rc:campaignNumber ?cn ; rc:affects/rc:ofModel/rc:ofMake ?mk }
        GROUP BY ?cn HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?mk) > 1)

question: List every recall campaign that covers the 2021 model-year Hyundai Santa Fe.
question_ko: 2021년식 싼타페가 대상인 리콜 캠페인을 모두 나열하라.
gold_sparql:
SELECT DISTINCT ?cn WHERE { ?c rc:campaignNumber ?cn ; rc:affects ?v .
          ?v rc:modelYear ?y ; rc:ofModel/rc:name "SANTA FE" . FILTER(STR(?y) = "2021") }

question: Which Genesis models were recalled for a detailed component category that was also recalled on the Kia Telluride?
question_ko: 텔루라이드 리콜과 같은 세부 부품 분류로 리콜된 Genesis 차종은?

question: Which vehicle model has the most recall campaigns in this dataset?
question_ko: 리콜 캠페인이 가장 많은 차종은?
gold_sparql: SELECT ?m (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c rc:affects/rc:ofModel/rc:name ?m } GROUP BY ?m ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1

question: How many Hyundai, Kia or Genesis recall campaigns were received in 2023?
question_ko: 2023년에 접수된 리콜 캠페인 수는?
gold_sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c rc:reportReceivedDate ?d . FILTER(YEAR(?d) = 2023) }

question: Which top-level component category has recalls affecting the largest number of distinct vehicle models?
question_ko: 가장 많은 차종에 걸쳐 리콜된 최상위 부품 분류는?
gold_sparql: SELECT ?top (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c rc:affectsComponent ?comp ; rc:affects/rc:ofModel ?m . ?comp skos:broader* ?t . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?t skos:broader ?x } ?t rc:name ?top . } GROUP BY ?top ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1

question: Among campaigns with a 'Park Outside' advisory, which one has the most potentially affected vehicles?
question_ko: '실외 주차' 권고 리콜 중 잠재 대상 대수가 가장 많은 캠페인은?
gold_sparql: SELECT ?cn ?n WHERE { ?c rc:parkOutside true ; rc:campaignNumber ?cn ; rc:potentiallyAffected ?n } ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1

question: How many of these recall campaigns were influenced by NHTSA's ODI (Office of Defects Investigation)?
question_ko: ODI(결함조사국) 주도로 시작된 리콜 캠페인 수는?
gold_sparql: SELECT (COUNT(?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c rc:initiatedBy "ODI" }

question: In recalls of Genesis vehicles, which top-level component category appears in the most campaigns?
question_ko: Genesis 리콜에서 캠페인 수가 가장 많은 최상위 부품 분류는?
gold_sparql: SELECT ?top (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c rc:affectsComponent ?comp ; rc:affects/rc:ofModel/rc:ofMake/rc:name "GENESIS" . ?comp skos:broader* ?t . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?t skos:broader ?x } ?t rc:name ?top . } GROUP BY ?top ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct model years of the Hyundai Sonata have at least one recall in this dataset?
question_ko: 리콜이 한 건 이상 있는 쏘나타 연식은 몇 개인가?
gold_sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?y) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel/rc:name "SONATA" ; rc:modelYear ?y }

question: In which year did NHTSA receive the most Hyundai, Kia or Genesis recall reports?
question_ko: 리콜 보고가 가장 많이 접수된 연도는?
gold_sparql: SELECT ?y (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c rc:reportReceivedDate ?d . BIND(YEAR(?d) AS ?y) } GROUP BY ?y ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1
